# zclone completion fish

Output fish completion script for zclone.

## Synopsis

Generates a fish autocompletion script for zclone.

This writes to /etc/fish/completions/zclone.fish by default so will
probably need to be run with sudo or as root, e.g.

```console
sudo zclone completion fish
```

Logout and login again to use the autocompletion scripts, or source
them directly

```console
. /etc/fish/completions/zclone.fish
```

If you supply a command line argument the script will be written
there.

If output_file is "-", then the output will be written to stdout.

```
zclone completion fish [output_file] [flags]
```

## Options

```
  -h, --help   help for fish
```

See the [global flags page](/flags/) for global options not listed here.
